description: Reviewer request 5: ablate which parameters are meta-learned. meta_layers=null means the default 4 conv adapters (block_1_1, block_2_0, block_4_1, block_5_0). To extend to batch-norm and classifier, pass an explicit layer list to MetaInit and ensure those layers expose lora_A/lora_B or are handled by the scope flag. This config documents the axis; the BN/classifier adapters require additional model plumbing (see notes).
note: BN and classifier layers do not yet have per-subject LoRA adapters; meta_layers scope flag is wired for the conv adapters and the plumbing in meta_init.get_adapter_params/freeze_backbone accepts arbitrary layer names, but adding adapters to BN/classifier is a model-side change in EEGNeX.py.
